STTH — Foundry Quick Start
Create a world using Sonic Tag-Team Heroes. Create a Character, NPC, or Vehicle in the Actors sidebar. Edit its attributes and skills on the sheet. Use the STTH Library to create the abilities, equipment, vehicle, and Henchmen compendiums, then drag entries onto actor sheets.

Playing
Use sheet controls to roll checks, resolve attacks, and track HP, TP, Rings, shields, and conditions. Configure attacks and equipment before use. The GM resolves unusual effects and circumstances using the STTH 1.5.0 book. This public package does not include the original rulebook or printable sheets.

Release status
Built for Foundry VTT 14. Automated engine and mocked integration tests pass; a live Foundry 14 session has not yet been tested. Custom powers and exceptional rulings may need GM handling. Original tabletop game by McShmoodle; unofficial community adaptation.
